tiers.name: Subtracting
tiers.description: Subtract integers. Subtracting a negative means adding.

tiers.name: Multiply & Divide
tiers.description: Multiply and divide integers. Watch the signs.

tiers.name: Mixed Signs
tiers.description: Two or three operations with negatives, in the right order.

tiers.name: Boss Level
tiers.description: Longer expressions, including powers of negative numbers.

NEG_NEG_ADD.student: Two negatives make a positive only when you multiply or divide.
NEG_NEG_ADD.teacher: Applies the multiplication sign rule to addition: −3 + (−5) = 8.

ADD_SIZES.student: Different signs: subtract the sizes, keep the sign of the bigger one.
ADD_SIZES.teacher: Adds absolute values when signs differ: −7 + 3 = −10.

WRONG_SIGN.student: Right size, wrong sign. Which number is farther from 0?
WRONG_SIGN.teacher: Correct magnitude, wrong sign on a sum or difference.

SUB_NEG.teacher: Treats subtracting a negative as subtracting a positive: 4 − (−6) = −2.

SIGN_RULE_PRODUCT.student: One negative makes it negative. Two negatives make it positive.
SIGN_RULE_PRODUCT.teacher: Wrong sign on a product or quotient; magnitude correct.

MUL_FOR_DIV.student: Divide, don't multiply: −12 ÷ 3 asks what times 3 makes −12.
MUL_FOR_DIV.teacher: Multiplies instead of dividing on a quotient with a negative: −12 ÷ 3 = −36.

ADD_FOR_MUL.student: × means groups: 4 × (−3) is 4 groups of −3, not 4 + (−3).
ADD_FOR_MUL.teacher: Adds instead of multiplying on a product with a negative: −6 × 4 = −2.

ORDER.teacher: Evaluates left to right, ignoring precedence, in a mixed-sign expression.
